Sophie (People Ops): Quick update: London hub will be closed tomorrow morning (Thu Feb 3) due to heavy snow and grit-safety concerns. We plan to re-open at 1pm unless local conditions change. Please do not come to the office before 12:30 PM.

WeatherBot (notify-bot): MET Office alert level: Yellow snow warning 04:00-14:00. Travel disruption likely.

Mark (Facilities): Gritting crew delayed until 10am. If roads are icy we will reassess; building heating is fine but external steps are hazardous. We'll post a door-status photo at 10:15 AM.

James (Eng): I had an onsite server maintenance scheduled for 9 AM. Can we reschedule or get remote access?

Sophie (People Ops): James, let's reschedule to 2 PM. If it's urgent and you need a keycard pickup, DM me and we can arrange an escorted access with Facilities.

Anna (Comms): For candidates/interviews: move all onsite interviews to remote or reschedule to afternoon. I'll notify candidates and interviewers now.

Sophie (People Ops): Shuttle note: the 07:45 and 08:30 shuttles are canceled tomorrow AM. Evening shuttles operate normally. Refunds issued automatically.

Mark (Facilities): Accessibility: if anyone requires assistance (mobility, medical), we will keep a ground-floor meeting room available and can arrange transportation. Email facilities-access@redwood.com.

Sophie (People Ops): If you planned travel today, please check with your manager about flexibility. People Ops will approve a day-of WFH for employees impacted by the closure.

James (Eng): Thanks, switching my maintenance to 2 PM.

Sophie (People Ops): We'll update here if reopening changes. Stay safe everyone :)
